reviews.title: Runs Cool & Crazy Fast After Tuning
reviews.comment: Got lucky with the silicon on this chip — absolute beast once you dial it in. I’ve got it running with an all-core CO at -30, no boost override, and stability is flawless. Also tweaked VCORE SOC and VDDG CCD/IOD in BIOS to keep memory and fabric happy, which made a huge difference. Temps stay cool even under full load thanks to a custom Corsair loop, and no crashes or throttling anywhere. Easy to install, compatible with X870 mobos and the power consumption top tier. Handles everything I throw at it — gaming, streaming, multitasking — buttery smooth. If you’re comfortable fine-tuning BIOS settings, there’s a lot of performance headroom here without sacrificing stability. Pair it with good cooling and this CPU will absolutely fly.
reviews.author: Justin P.

reviews.title: Great processor.
reviews.comment: Solid performing for all my games. I did hold off on upgrading ever since my ryzen 7 2700x. I pushed that as far as it would go before buying this. I have been very happy with the Ryzen series. This runs everything fast and smooth for both gaming and every day computing.
reviews.author: Adrian Cruz

reviews.title: AMD !
reviews.comment: Awesome CPU handles everything I throw at it, (games, analysis software, CAD, programming). Had some issues during installation needed new bios but worked instantly post update. I also own the 5950x and 7900x, which still work great, however this one blows past the previous gens. Temps run 40s and 60s but never goes beyond 80.
reviews.author: NR

reviews.title: Works as expected, no regrets.
reviews.comment: Great product! I managed to bring temp down to 70-75 degrees with a good fan (almost no noise) and undervolting (1.1 V, 5.1 GHz) with just a few percent of CPU performance drop in tests. Totally satisfied.
reviews.author: Gekz

reviews.title: An Absolute Beast for Creative Work
reviews.comment: I installed this card in my recent PC build, and it has completely exceeded my expectations. I paired this with an AMD Radeon 9070xt GPU and use a 3-fan liquid cooling unit on the CPU. In real use, this thing is a workhorse. In Blender, viewport performance is buttery smooth even with complex scenes, heavy geometry, and high-resolution textures. Cycles renders are significantly faster and tasks like baking, denoising, and simulation previews feel far less painful than before. In Unreal Engine 5, the card absolutely shines. Lumen, Nanite, and high-quality lighting run with far fewer stutters than I expected, even in detailed environments. Large open worlds load quickly, and I can work at higher settings without constantly worrying about frame drops or performance bottlenecks. For game development and 3D work, it feels like I finally have headroom instead of constantly fighting hardware limits.
reviews.author: Carl LaLonde
